\documentclass[border=4pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows,positioning}

% Source-derived from the legacy open triangle 90 declaration.
\makeatletter
\pgfarrowsdeclare{adaptive open map}{adaptive open map}
{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.5pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowsleftextend{-.5\pgflinewidth}
  \pgfutil@tempdimb=6\pgfutil@tempdima
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdimb by.707\pgflinewidth
  \pgfarrowsrightextend{\pgfutil@tempdimb}
}
{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.5pt
  \advance\pgfutil@tempdima by.25\pgflinewidth
  \pgfsetmiterjoin
  \pgfsetbuttcap
  \pgfpathmoveto{\pgfqpoint{0pt}{-6\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{6\pgfutil@tempdima}{0pt}}
  \pgfpathlineto{\pgfqpoint{0pt}{6\pgfutil@tempdima}}
  \pgfpathclose
  \pgfusepathqstroke
}
\makeatother

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  node distance=16mm and 24mm,
  object/.style={draw,circle,minimum size=10mm,inner sep=1pt}
]
  \node[object,fill=blue!8] (V) {$V$};
  \node[object,fill=green!10,right=of V] (W) {$W$};
  \node[object,fill=orange!10,below=of V] (X) {$X$};
  \node[object,fill=purple!8,right=of X] (Y) {$Y$};

  \draw[blue,line width=.4pt,-{adaptive open map}] (V) -- node[above] {$f$} (W);
  \draw[purple,line width=1pt,-{adaptive open map}] (X) -- node[below] {$g$} (Y);
  \draw[red,line width=1.6pt,-{adaptive open map}] (V) -- node[left] {$p$} (X);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
